audit_type: Independent AEO Score Challenge & Evidence Verification

evidence_ledger.claim: All 13 public routes are canonically declared in sitemap.xml, robots.txt, and return HTTP 200 without redirect loops.
evidence_ledger.observed_result: All 13 canonical URLs return HTTP 200 OK with strict nosniff and HSTS headers. /docs Swagger duplicate removed from sitemap.

evidence_ledger.claim: 100% of public routes contain unique title, meta description, canonical link, Open Graph, and Twitter Cards.
evidence_ledger.observed_result: 13/13 pages validated for unique title (>10 chars), description (>50 chars), canonical URL, OG tags, and Twitter cards.

evidence_ledger.claim: All pages contain valid JSON-LD Schema.org graphs without syntax errors or unverified review self-nominations.
evidence_ledger.observed_result: 13/13 pages parse valid JSON-LD (@type: SoftwareApplication, TechArticle, FAQPage, BreadcrumbList, WebPage, AboutPage). Disclaimed guaranteed FAQ rich snippet eligibility per Google 2023 policy.
evidence_ledger.score_impact: 14 / 15 in Category C (Structured Data & Entity Clarity) - 1 pt deducted for external Search Console rich result live verification

evidence_ledger.claim: Every public page has exactly one top-level H1 tag and clear direct answer definitions under the heading.
evidence_ledger.observed_result: Exactly 1 H1 per page, concise opening answer definitions, structured comparison tables, step-by-step lifecycles.

evidence_ledger.claim: High content quality with accurate fintech domain terminology, mathematical Weibull retry models, and open-source license attribution.
evidence_ledger.test_performed: Manual code & text audit across all 13 landing pages
evidence_ledger.observed_result: Deep mathematical explanations of dual-speed recovery, Redis CAS mutexes, and Indian payment rail adapters. Transparent MIT license.
evidence_ledger.score_impact: 14 / 15 in Category E (Content Quality & Trust) - 1 pt reserved for third-party external academic citations

evidence_ledger.claim: Full bidirectional internal navigation linking topic clusters across Architecture, AI Recovery, Idempotency, Audit Ledger, FAQ, Privacy, and Terms.
evidence_ledger.test_performed: Static link traversal audit across headers, footers, and breadcrumbs
evidence_ledger.observed_result: 0 broken internal links, consistent header navigation, breadcrumbs on all 12 sub-pages, cross-linking in footers.
evidence_ledger.score_impact: 8 / 8 in Category F (Internal Linking & Topic Clusters)

evidence_ledger.claim: Deep landing pages are ultra-lightweight (<12KB) with <150ms FCP; root interactive dashboard is 705KB with 2 CDN script tags.
evidence_ledger.observed_result: Deep pages: 6.55KB to 12.14KB HTML payload, 0 blocking external stylesheets, FCP < 120ms. Root SPA: 705.1KB, FCP ~450ms.
evidence_ledger.score_impact: 8 / 10 in Category G (Rendering & Performance) - 2 pts deducted for root SPA payload size and CDN script dependencies

evidence_ledger.claim: Explicit AI crawler permissions in robots.txt for GPTBot, ClaudeBot, PerplexityBot, OAI-SearchBot, Applebot; live llms.txt endpoints.
evidence_ledger.observed_result: All 8 major AI crawlers explicitly allowed; llms.txt (2.4KB) and llms-full.txt (3.3KB) served at /llms.txt, /.well-known/llms.txt, and /llms-full.txt.
evidence_ledger.score_impact: 5 / 5 in Category H (AI Crawler Policy & External Discoverability)

evidence_ledger.claim: Security headers enforced; automated regression testing suite active; zero plaintext credentials exposed in HTML.
evidence_ledger.observed_result: nosniff, frame protection, HSTS headers active on all routes. No secret keys found in public templates.
evidence_ledger.score_impact: 6 / 7 in Category I (Security & Regression Resilience) - 1 pt reserved for production DNS/TLS certificate inspection
